source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    Enter BMC Web UI -> Select "Hardware status" > Click tab "Inventory and LEDs" then check the Fans information and detail information

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
1. Data should be readable and correct.
2. Check the every fans status is fit actual status
3. Check Fan speed is correct.

deepseek_columns.ai_commands: curl -s -k -u "$BMC_USER:$BMC_PASS" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -X GET https://$BMC_IP/redfish/v1/Chassis/FRU_SYS/Thermal | jq .Fans | range(0;8) as $i | .Fans[$i] | select(.Name|test("_R";"i"))
deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: return FULL pretty-printed JSON from /redfish/v1/Chassis/FRU_SYS/Thermal (rear fan SPD_*_R readings) so user can read/diff against SPEC for "SPD_FAN1_R~SPD_FAN16_R". No RISK (read-only).

historical_reviews.deepseek: YES limits inspection to eight array positions for a sixteen-channel `_R` title, assumes path/order and omits exact rotor/physical mapping, units, thresholds and freshness.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION / CHANGED requires all sixteen rear records with topology, speed/status/threshold evidence and no-control/no-fault safeguards.
historical_reviews.round_02: Entry 970/2291 accepts half-coverage under a generic execution gate.
historical_reviews.related_source_cases: The preceding `_F` family is separate front-side/paired-rotor coverage; earlier `_R` cases confirm suffix semantics must be approved, not inferred as universal.
historical_reviews.v3_1: ED-33 preserves `_R`; ED-34 permits approved telemetry tools; ED-35 retains sixteen-channel functional coverage without hazardous stimulus; ED-36 treats topology/ranges as readiness.

original_test_intent: Verify SPD_FAN1_R through SPD_FAN16_R are individually readable, match actual fan status and report correct speed in BMC WebUI.
original_method: Enumerate the complete fan collection, map all `_R` channels to the approved rear-side or paired-rotor topology, collect structured RPM, presence, health, thresholds and freshness, and correlate with WebUI plus safe observation without changing fan state.
manual_activity: The owner defines `_R`, maps sixteen channels to physical fans/rotors and supplies acceptable ranges; operator provides safe visual/UI correlation, and engineer owns final acceptance.
safety_requirements: Do not change PWM/thresholds, disconnect fans, inject faults, alter power or reset.
Do not treat range(0;8) as coverage of sixteen channels.
Use trusted transport and protected credentials.
Do not claim airflow or thermal margin from RPM alone.
Stop on unexplained missing/duplicate channels or stale values without automatic retry.
agent_execution_scope: Traverse the complete fan collection and all pages.
Resolve SPD_FAN1_R through SPD_FAN16_R by vendor topology.
Compare ranges and correlate WebUI/safe observation.
Return evidence only with fan controls unchanged.
engineer_actions: Review exceptions and issue formal verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Does not meet title coverage: eight indexes and substring filtering cannot prove sixteen exact rear/rotor channels, physical status, thresholds or trusted telemetry.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Enumerate every fan member and explicitly reconcile all sixteen `_R` channels to the approved physical map using structured numeric/unit evidence.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: All sixteen `_R` names, WebUI method, three Criteria and original time values remain preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use complete sixteen-channel rear/rotor telemetry reconciliation with safe observation and no-control constraints.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record BMC, thermal schema and parser versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Vendor fan/controller topology and Project cooling limits.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds full channel enumeration, suffix/topology authority, unit/threshold/freshness checks and explicit safety while retaining UI verification.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Eight array entries or RPM alone are partial and cannot establish sixteen actual fan states or cooling performance.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Sixteen-channel `_R` map and accepted telemetry/state ranges.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Array order and labels may diverge from physical slots; any fan manipulation could reduce cooling and is excluded.

project_override_considerations: Alternate collectors require all sixteen approved identities, equivalent units/states/freshness, engineer approval and explicit recording of any uncovered WebUI/physical checkpoint.

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Title and Criteria agree on sixteen rear/`_R` fan channels; the eight-index command is incomplete guidance rather than an alternate scope.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The sixteen-channel telemetry objective is clear; exact suffix/topology and acceptable ranges are readiness inputs.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Corrects eight-of-sixteen coverage and adds physical identity, units, thresholds and freshness.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Independently agrees with hybrid classification and no-control boundary.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.round_02: Rejects generic acceptance of an internally incomplete command.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.related_source_cases: Keeps `_R` coverage independent from `_F` and earlier fan-speed variants.

review_improvement: Makes every rear/paired-rotor channel accountable and prevents array-order or half-coverage false passes.
independent_technical_reasoning: A sixteen-channel fan family cannot be validated by sampling the first eight collection elements, especially when logical order may not match physical topology. Each `_R` channel needs an authoritative position/rotor mapping, time-stamped unit-aware speed and state evidence, while active fan manipulation remains outside this inventory check.
